description: Tutorial night, one value per 30 s epoch. Powers in uV^2 (Welch, 4 s windows, after a 0.3-35 Hz band-pass). stage: automatic staging by NanoSleepNet (not validated on Portiloop data). sound: fraction of the epoch with detection/stimulation running (stimulation_on). cz_rail: fraction of Cz samples at the ADS1299 limit (electrode off).
